name: WE Invoice
tagline: Invoicing and e-invoicing, free. Genuinely free.
description: Invoices, e-invoicing via Peppol, bank imports, payment reminders, expenses, VAT filings and single-entry bookkeeping for sole traders and small businesses in Slovakia and the Czech Republic. No sign-up, no limits and no paid plans. Your data is encrypted in your own Google Drive, not on someone else's server. Open source under the MIT licence.
features: Invoices, proformas, credit notes, quotes and sales receipts with a PAY by square QR code
E-invoicing via Peppol with a provider of your choice
Bank statement imports and automatic payment matching
Three-level payment reminders with late-payment interest
Receipt and eKasa QR code scanning right on your device
VAT control statement, EC sales list and VAT return as XML
Single-entry bookkeeping and the groundwork for your tax return
Six interface languages, documents printed bilingually too

faq.a: It has almost no running costs: your data is in your Google Drive, the site runs on GitHub and you pay for e-invoicing directly to your provider. For White Eagles the app is a showcase of its work and a way to reach small business owners.
Encrypted on your device and in your Google Drive. The White Eagles server is just a gateway to e-invoicing providers and registers; it stores nothing.

faq.q: Do I have to receive e-invoices from 2027?
faq.a: Yes, every business in Slovakia, including non-VAT payers. WE Invoice receives them in full, every line included, through a provider where receiving is often free.
No. It prepares the groundwork and exports; responsibility for tax documents stays with you or your accountant.
